#!/bin/bash

# Script to install fonts for the workspace
# This script downloads and installs various fonts

set -e

FONTS_DIR="$HOME/.local/share/fonts"
mkdir -p "$FONTS_DIR"

echo "Installing fonts..."

# Install Nerd Fonts - FiraCode
echo "Downloading FiraCode Nerd Font..."
wget -q https://github.com/ryanoasis/nerd-fonts/releases/download/v3.0.2/FiraCode.zip -O /tmp/FiraCode.zip
unzip -q /tmp/FiraCode.zip -d /tmp/FiraCode
cp /tmp/FiraCode/*.ttf "$FONTS_DIR/"

# Install Nerd Fonts - Hack
echo "Downloading Hack Nerd Font..."
wget -q https://github.com/ryanoasis/nerd-fonts/releases/download/v3.0.2/Hack.zip -O /tmp/Hack.zip
unzip -q /tmp/Hack.zip -d /tmp/Hack
cp /tmp/Hack/*.ttf "$FONTS_DIR/"

# Install Nerd Fonts - JetBrainsMono
echo "Downloading JetBrainsMono Nerd Font..."
wget -q https://github.com/ryanoasis/nerd-fonts/releases/download/v3.0.2/JetBrainsMono.zip -O /tmp/JetBrainsMono.zip
unzip -q /tmp/JetBrainsMono.zip -d /tmp/JetBrainsMono
cp /tmp/JetBrainsMono/*.ttf "$FONTS_DIR/"

# Install Google Fonts - Roboto
echo "Downloading Roboto..."
wget -q https://fonts.google.com/download?family=Roboto -O /tmp/Roboto.zip
unzip -q /tmp/Roboto.zip -d /tmp/Roboto
cp /tmp/Roboto/*.ttf "$FONTS_DIR/"

# Install Google Fonts - Open Sans
echo "Downloading Open Sans..."
wget -q "https://fonts.google.com/download?family=Open+Sans" -O /tmp/OpenSans.zip
unzip -q /tmp/OpenSans.zip -d /tmp/OpenSans
find /tmp/OpenSans -name "*.ttf" -exec cp {} "$FONTS_DIR/" \;

# Update font cache
echo "Updating font cache..."
fc-cache -f -v "$FONTS_DIR"

echo "Font installation complete!"
echo "Installed fonts:"
fc-list : family | sort
</tool_response>
